operator_notes_2026_08_10: The genuine current-week bulletin (e.g. 090826_Bulletin_19th-Sunday-Ordinary-Time.pdf, correctly dated for 2026-08-09) is a real 5-page PDF: 3 pages of real notices + 2 near-blank trailing pages. The default MAX_BULLETIN_PAGES=4 guard was discarding it every week as 'oversized' even though the recipe (click 'Download' -> *.pdf) works correctly and picks the right dated file. Raised the limit to 6 to give a little headroom past 5 without opening the door to genuinely oversized non-bulletin documents.
